skill.name: shadcn-ui
skill.description: Build modern React UIs with shadcn/ui components. Covers component installation, customization, theming, form integration, and accessibility. Use for React applications with Tailwind CSS, design system implementation, and rapid UI development.

generated_query: I'm working on a React app with Tailwind CSS and need to build a user profile settings page. I want a form with fields for name, email, and bio, with client-side validation using Zod and React Hook Form. Also need a dialog for changing the password, with a form inside that has password and confirm password fields. And a card component to show the current profile summary with an edit button. How can I set these up quickly, including the necessary component installations and code?
